_readme: Review overlay. `labels` numbers EVERY strip item (all sections) in page order: trail stops in walk order, then indoor pieces; within a stop, Now → Construction → Drawings → Aerial → Then → Construction → Drawings. `remove` red-borders keys; empty for now. Empty both to clear the overlay. `groups` is the record of the 2026-09-20 duplicate review (its labels used that review's now-only numbering).
policy: Reviewed by eye on 2026-09-20, erring on NOT calling something a duplicate. Red only for true burst twins: the same frame within a few seconds with nothing but a figure moving, or a second clip repeating an existing still+clip pair. Portrait vs landscape, a different distance or angle, a different day's light, and a still paired with its own clip all stay.

groups.why: same frame 2 s apart; only the figures by the cart moved
three portraits from one spot a few seconds apart; the flagged one is the in-between zoom of the other two
identical close-ups from below, 14 s apart
2 s apart; the dog took one step
same close-up of the sconce; the flagged one is a touch wider
a still with its clip, then a second clip of the same framing 3 s later; the second clip is the flagged one
